summary.tldr: Updates the Old Age Security Act so one program payment is deducted from income.
what_it_does: Replaces the reference in the Old Age Security Act’s income definition with the payment under the program in section 276 of the Budget Implementation Act, 2021, No. 1.
Keeps that payment out of a person’s income for Old Age Security calculations, if it was included in income for the year.
summary.background: The Old Age Security Act defines income by starting with income under the Income Tax Act, then subtracting certain amounts.
